Perfect Water Proclamation Hill is a branch of the Perfect Water franchise network that opened at this address in 2024, part of a brand formed when Perfect Water, founded in 1999, and Absolutely Water joined forces in 2010 to create one of Africa's leading water purification and bottled-water groups, now with more than 100 branches across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Eswatini and Zimbabwe.

The Proclamation Hill shop lets customers bring their own container for a refill, or buy ready-bottled water, and also supplies personalised bottled water for companies, schools and events wanting their own branded bottles. Alongside drinking water, the shop stocks water purification and filtration equipment and replacement filters, giving WF Nkomo Street customers both an everyday water refill stop and a source of home filtration gear in one visit.

Pest Control Specialists™ Pretoria East has operated from its Meyerspark branch since April 2002, trading under a pest-control brand that has been active in South Africa since 1978. The branch handles wood-destroying insects such as termites and borer beetles, nuisance pests including cockroaches, ants and rodents, and stored-product pests, alongside bat control and lawn care treatments.

For commercial clients such as food and health-industry premises, the branch runs an integrated pest management programme designed to meet the stricter hygiene standards those sites require, and also offers professional disinfection services. The branch has built a strong reputation locally, reflected in several hundred customer reviews praising its technicians' professionalism. Based on Watermeyer Street in Meyerspark, it serves homes and businesses across Pretoria East looking for an established, long-running pest control provider.

Plan B Bistro in Menlo Park serves bistro fare, burgers and light meals across breakfast, lunch and dinner, alongside a selection of cocktails and wines for those settling in for a longer meal. The menu is built around approachable, everyday dishes rather than a fine-dining format, making it a practical choice for a casual meal out.

The bistro is both pet-friendly and family-friendly, with free Wi-Fi for customers who want to work or browse over a coffee, and wheelchair access for visitors with mobility needs. Trading on 13th Street in Menlo Park, Plan B Bistro serves a cross-section of local diners, from families with pets in tow to people after a relaxed breakfast or evening drink, without the formality of a traditional restaurant.

This Lynnwood Bridge branch of Planet Fitness offers a full range of gym facilities, including a cardio deck, a functional training area, a free weights section, and dedicated indoor cycling and group exercise studios. Members also have access to an InBody body-composition machine and a steam room, giving the club both training variety and recovery facilities under one roof.

Change rooms, free parking and free Wi-Fi round out the practical side of the club, which trades from the Lynnwood Bridge centre on the corner of Lynnwood and Daventry Road. Open from early morning on weekdays, with separate weekend hours, the club suits members training before or after work as well as those with a more flexible weekend routine, serving Lynnwood Manor and the wider Pretoria area.

Plant Ranch is a family-owned garden centre in Lyttelton that has served the Centurion area since 1988, stocking indoor and outdoor plants, indigenous varieties, trees and fruit trees alongside herb, vegetable and flower seedlings, succulents and cacti. The centre also carries garden decor, irrigation accessories and fertilisers and organics, giving gardeners most of what they need for a planting project in one stop.

Families are well catered for too, with a children's play area and tea garden on site so a visit can turn into an outing rather than a quick plant run. Open daily, including Sundays and public holidays, Plant Ranch trades from Rabie Street in Lyttelton AH and serves gardeners across Centurion looking for a long-established, locally owned nursery rather than a big-box garden department.

Plantland Cornwall Hill is a family-run garden centre in Irene, one of four Plantland branches across Pretoria, offering a wide selection of plants from seedlings to trees, along with herbs and vegetables for gardeners wanting to grow their own produce. The centre also stocks pots and garden statues for those finishing off a garden's look rather than just planting it.

A coffee shop and a children's play area are part of the Cornwall Hill site, making it a place to spend a morning rather than just a stop for supplies. Plantland is a well-known Pretoria brand with a strong social media following across its branches, and the Cornwall Hill centre keeps seasonal hours, opening slightly later on winter mornings. It serves gardeners across Irene and Centurion looking for a full-service nursery rather than a plant aisle in a hardware store.

PostNet Waverley is a business services outlet in Waverley Plaza, Villieria, offering courier services, copy and print work, stationery and mailbox rental under the PostNet franchise. Print services cover A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing and name badges, alongside rubber stamps for office and personal use.

The branch also stocks general convenience stationery and packaging material for customers sending parcels, and offers Vox website services for small businesses wanting an online presence alongside their printing and courier needs. Trading Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 16:00, closed Sundays, PostNet Waverley serves Villieria and the surrounding Waverley area as a single stop for printing, postage and small-business support services.

Pots And Plants is a plant nursery in Eloffsdal offering a wide range of plants, pots, stones and garden decor, along with landscaping services for customers who want help designing a garden rather than just buying the pieces for one. Knowledgeable staff are on hand to help customers choose plants suited to their specific homes and gardens, from shade-loving varieties to hardier options for full sun.

The nursery also sells decorative items such as sets of park-style pots in a range of sizes, letting customers finish a patio or entrance area alongside their plant purchases. Trading from the corner of 5th Avenue and Franzina Street in Eloffsdal, Pots And Plants has built a loyal local following, serving gardeners across the suburb who want personal advice alongside their nursery shopping.

Pretoria Gates, established in 2021, manufactures custom gates and carports and installs Clearview and palisade fencing, electric fences and gate motors, drawing on more than seven years of expertise in access control and security automation from its East Lynne base. The company also builds balustrades and staircases and takes on broader steel structure and custom steel projects, from compact storage units to larger structures built to withstand South African weather conditions.

Beyond gates and fencing, the team installs garage doors and CCTV camera systems, giving customers a single installer for several parts of a property's perimeter and access security. Trading from Stormvoël Road in East Lynne, Pretoria Gates serves homeowners and businesses across Pretoria who want gates, fencing, garage doors and surveillance handled by one access-automation specialist.

The Pretoria Hotel is a three-star hotel in Arcadia offering air-conditioned rooms, self-catering suites, conference facilities and rooftop views of the Union Buildings. Set in the heart of Tshwane, it positions itself as good-value accommodation for travellers who want to be close to government and business districts without paying for a five-star stay.

Its restaurant serves international cuisine with vegetarian and halal options, catering to a broad mix of business and leisure guests, and the hotel also offers billiards and darts for guests looking for something to do in the evening. With conference venues on site, the Pretoria Hotel is used for both overnight stays and business functions, serving visitors and local companies who need affordable accommodation and meeting space in the centre of Pretoria.

The Public Investment Corporation is a South African state-owned asset manager with origins dating back to 1911, corporatised into its current form in 2005. It is Africa's largest asset manager, with more than R2.6 trillion in assets under management, and invests pension and public-sector funds, most notably the Government Employees Pension Fund, on behalf of its clients.

As one of the entities through which the South African government advances Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment, the PIC holds substantial stakes in a range of South African companies alongside its pension-fund investments. Operating from Menlyn Maine Central Square in Waterkloof Glen, the Public Investment Corporation manages the retirement savings of government employees and other public-sector clients at a scale few other asset managers in Africa can match.

Ragon Industries manufactures butterfly, knife gate and ball valves for slurry and other highly abrasive industrial applications, trading under its own RAGMAX, RAGGATE and V-PORT valve lines from Montana Park, Pretoria. Its experience in plant processes and layout has shaped valve designs aimed specifically at harsh, high-wear operating conditions rather than general industrial use.

The company has also invested in its own high-velocity oxygen fuel spraying equipment, letting it apply wear- and corrosion-resistant coatings to discs, blades and valve bodies in-house rather than outsourcing the process. This combination of valve manufacturing and in-house coating work lets Ragon Industries offer a more complete product to customers in mining, slurry handling and other abrasive-material industries, backed by competitively priced, locally manufactured equipment.

RAS Security Services (Pty) Ltd is a Centurion-based security company offering armed and unarmed guard services to residential properties in and around Olievenhoutbosch. The company maintains an active online presence, with a Facebook following of close to fourteen thousand people, which it uses to share operational updates alongside job vacancies for prospective guards.

That scale of following is unusual for a residential guarding company of its size, and reflects a business that has built a visible local profile beyond just the guards posted at client properties. Based in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, RAS Security Services serves residential clients in the area looking for a locally known guarding provider, with its social media presence giving both clients and prospective staff an easy way to stay in touch with the company.

RE/MAX Jowic - Werner Eksteen, based on a farm portion in Zwavelpoort, is built around an agent with more than 39 years of real estate experience, including over 20 years as principal of his own practice. Werner Eksteen has personally sold more than 3,000 properties and over 30 developments across his career, and acts as a consultant to several property developers in the area.

Over the past 24 years, the practice has specialised in densified farm land and upmarket country lifestyle properties to the east and north-east of Pretoria, and is currently handling the first one-hectare agricultural farm subdivision in the area since the Covid pandemic. It also brokers commercial farm sales through a network spanning Limpopo, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, North West and the Northern Cape, alongside residential, commercial and industrial property in Zwavelpoort itself.

RFS Administrators (Pty) Ltd is a pension and provident fund administrator established in 1997, built around a flexible range of benefit products rather than a one-size retirement fund offering. Over nearly three decades the company has grown to serve more than 30,000 fund members, administering retirement fund solutions from its Montana Pavilion offices.

The firm holds authorisation as a Financial Service Provider under the FAIS Act, and combines its administration systems with personal involvement from its consultants, aiming to keep both the technical and relationship side of fund management in house. Based in Montana Gardens, RFS Administrators serves employers and retirement funds across South Africa that want an experienced, FAIS-authorised administrator managing members' benefits rather than handling fund administration internally.

Rietondale Music Centre offers music lessons in guitar, including classical, acoustic and electric styles, along with piano, violin, recorder, harp and voice, plus music theory classes for students working towards exams. Lessons are open to children from as young as eight as well as adult beginners, with Saturday slots available for adults and students who can't make lessons during the week.

Students preparing for formal qualifications are supported through UNISA, Royal Schools and Trinity exam syllabuses, and the centre runs ensemble work each year so pupils across the different instruments can perform together. That mix of structured exam preparation and informal group performance gives students at Rietondale Music Centre, on the corner of Soutpansberg and Nuffield Streets, both a technical and a social reason to keep coming back.

Ryankim Manufacturing is a precision engineering business in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, established in 2007 and built around Omax waterjet profiling equipment. Its Tilt-a-Jet precision cutting capability lets the workshop handle thicker materials than standard waterjet cutting allows, broadening the range of jobs it can take on beyond thin sheet work.

Alongside waterjet cutting, the workshop offers light CNC milling and turning, NC bending and TIG welding, giving it a small but versatile set of metalworking services under one roof rather than specialising in cutting alone. The business prides itself on guaranteed workmanship and on-time delivery, and trades from Ellman Street in Sunderland Ridge, serving manufacturers and fabricators across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area who need precision-cut or welded metal components.

S&R Enterprises is a proud distributor of Sandvik Rock Processing equipment, founded in January 2012 and built on experience in the crushing and screening industry. The company supplies new and used mobile, wheeled and static crushers and screens, including jaw, cone and impact crushers, to the quarrying, construction and mining industries, alongside drill rigs, parts and field service support.

Where customers have their own equipment, S&R Enterprises also carries out individual evaluations of crushing and screening machinery, helping clients understand its condition and market value before a sale or trade-in, and can introduce them to the relevant original equipment manufacturer. Based in Monavoni, Centurion, S&R Enterprises serves mining and construction operators across Southern Africa who need both new equipment and support for machinery they already own.

SA Technologies (Pty) Ltd builds VisitMe, a POPIA-compliant visitor-management and access-control platform designed to replace paper logbooks at the gate. The system combines a handheld scanner that reads driver's licence and vehicle disc barcodes, an online portal for centralised reporting and multi-site oversight, and a mobile app for visitor pre-booking and remote gate access management.

Built and hosted locally in South Africa, VisitMe is designed for estates, logistics operations, mining and manufacturing sites, office parks and other commercial properties that need real-time entry and exit records rather than a paper register. Beyond visitor access, the platform also handles staff time-and-attendance tracking and asset-movement control. Based in Boardwalk Manor, Faerie Glen, SA Technologies serves site operators across South Africa who need custom-built, rather than generic, access control technology.

SACPCMP, the South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions, regulates and promotes the built-environment management professions, maintaining the national register of practitioners in construction health and safety, project and construction management, and building inspection. The council sets the rules and codes of conduct that registered professionals in these fields must follow.

Its work includes publishing tenders, vacancies and regulatory gazettes, managing an annual registration calendar, and running a recognition-of-prior-learning process for practitioners seeking registration through experience rather than formal qualification alone. The council also hosts an annual conference and masterclasses for the professions it regulates. Based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, SACPCMP serves construction and project management professionals across South Africa who need to register, renew or understand their obligations under its regulatory framework.

SDM Consulting offers enterprise asset management, inventory management, independent asset valuations and CFO advisory support to public and private sector clients, combining technology with industry expertise across a continent-wide footprint. Its asset management service aims to give clients full visibility, accuracy and compliance across their asset base, supporting better decisions and improved audit outcomes.

Inventory management work focuses on tracking, verifying and controlling consumables, stock and equipment to reduce losses and keep financial records accurate, while its valuation service supports financial reporting and strategic planning with independent, compliant assessments. The firm also provides document management, skills transfer and asset-tracking technology such as IoT, RFID and drone surveillance. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, SDM Consulting serves organisations across Africa needing stronger oversight and compliance around the assets they hold.

Security Med 24 is a Pretoria-based security company combining armed and unarmed guarding, CCTV surveillance, alarm monitoring and gate and vehicle tracking with on-site, medically trained first responders. That medical capability is free to clients and covers both crime-related trauma and non-crime emergencies such as cardiac events, diabetic episodes, seizures and maternity emergencies, with the team coordinating ambulance services when needed.

Its armed response unit is PSIRA-accredited and backed by a mobile panic app and physical panic devices for GPS-enabled dispatch, while CCTV monitoring runs around the clock with AI-assisted alert verification before a response team is sent. Guarding services extend to canine units and patrol vehicles for estates and businesses. Based in Sinoville, Security Med 24 sets itself apart from standard guarding companies through this built-in medical response element.

Security Warehouse, headquartered in Hennopspark since its founding in 1997, is a South African distributor of electronic security equipment that started by importing CCTV cameras from Taiwan. It has since grown into one of the country's leading distributors of CCTV, access control, alarm, gate automation, electric fencing and solar security equipment, serving installers and dealers rather than only end customers.

Alongside its Centurion headquarters, the company runs branches in the East Rand, Boksburg, Strijdom Park and the West Rand, and operates a PSIRA and SASSETA-accredited training academy that trains installers on its product range. Its services extend into solution design, product training, technical support, financing and turnkey project management, giving trade customers backup beyond simply buying equipment off the shelf. Security Warehouse supplies the security industry across Gauteng from its Hennopspark base.

ShapeUp Family Gym's Wonderboom branch, in the basement of Wonderboom Junction Mall, was the first gym to open under the ShapeUp Family Health Club name in 2000, before the group expanded to branches in Thabazimbi and Lephalale. The Wonderboom club offers weight training, cardio, aerobics and spinning classes, plus circuit and functional training, steam and sauna facilities, and childcare for members training with young kids in tow.

A particular feature is the chain's first dedicated private ladies' gym, built inside the main gym floor, along with upmarket change rooms offering separate wet and dry areas for getting ready after a workout. New members can also book a low-cost one-hour consultation with an instructor for exercise and dietary advice. Trading from Wonderboom Junction Mall, the branch serves Wonderboom and the surrounding northern suburbs.

Silverton Bearings & Seals Pretoria Gauteng, trading as Silverton Automotive, supplies automotive and wheel bearings, gearbox bearings, clutches, belts and seals from brands including LUK, INA, FAG, NSK and SKF. The company is not an agent or distributor for any of these brands but stocks them directly as an independent supplier, serving spares shops, workshops and mechanics with a 24-hour delivery service aimed at getting parts to customers within 72 hours of ordering.

Silverton Automotive is a fully black South African owned and majority woman-owned company, rated a B-BBEE level 1 empowered supplier, and backs its products with a guarantee on all items sold. Trading from Fakkel Street in Silverton, the business serves auto electricians, mechanics and the general public across Pretoria who need genuine automotive bearing and seal parts delivered quickly rather than sourced through a middleman.

Simply Fab Media (Pty) Ltd is a diversified investment and engineering firm working across civil, mining and mechanical engineering, infrastructure investment, commodity trading and fuel supply. Its consulting and investment arm backs well-resourced projects with manageable risk, while its engineering teams design, build and manage infrastructure and extract and process minerals across different natural environments.

The firm's project footprint extends beyond South Africa into Namibia, Zambia, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Zimbabwe, reflecting a regional rather than purely local operation. Its fuel supply division aims to provide reliable, cost-effective fuel with global delivery alongside high-quality products, complementing its engineering and infrastructure investment work. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, Simply Fab Media serves clients and partners across Southern Africa needing engineering delivery alongside infrastructure and commodity investment expertise.

Smit Compliance is a legal and regulatory compliance consultancy in Rietfontein, Pretoria, offering HR and labour consulting, health and safety and environmental compliance audits, and contract drafting for businesses that need to meet legislative requirements without building that expertise in house. The practice positions itself as independent, objective and unbiased, working across legal, SHEQ, labour and HR fields rather than specialising in just one.

Training is a core part of its offering, covering POPI, employment law and occupational health and safety, aimed at helping staff understand and work comfortably within a compliance programme rather than treating it as a box-ticking exercise imposed from outside. Open on weekdays, Smit Compliance trades from Hertzog Street in Rietfontein and serves businesses across Pretoria that need practical, affordable compliance support rather than a costly corporate legal department.

SolarAfrica Energy provides commercial and industrial energy solutions including financed on-site solar and battery installations, electricity wheeling and trading, and gas-to-power systems, working with businesses across agriculture, manufacturing and retail to cut costs and improve energy security. Its on-site power offering is fully financed, with maintenance, monitoring, insurance and a performance guarantee built into the service rather than left to the client.

For businesses that want greener power without installing their own system, SolarAfrica also offers virtual power products such as wheeling, trading and aggregation, letting clients buy cheaper or renewable electricity without physical infrastructure on their own site. The company has delivered energy projects for over a decade and operates its own SunCentral solar farm as part of its supply. Based in Irene, Pretoria, SolarAfrica Energy serves businesses wanting to manage electricity costs without taking on capital risk themselves.

Solo Pro Contractors (PTY) LTD is a family-owned electrical and solar installation company operating since 2003, accredited by the Electrical Contractors Association. The business started out building homes from the ground up before evolving into the electrical industry and, more recently, focusing on solar energy solutions for both residential and commercial clients.

Solar systems range from 5kW to 50kW, with the company managing every stage from consultation through to installation and after-care, rather than just supplying panels and leaving clients to arrange their own fitting. It continues to offer general electrical and construction work alongside solar, and selects only vetted, warrantied products for installation. Trading from Heimia Avenue in Wonderboom, Solo Pro Contractors serves homeowners and businesses across Pretoria wanting an established, accredited contractor for both electrical work and solar conversion.

Stackworx is a software engineering firm in Alphen Park building end-to-end web and mobile platforms, covering analysis and discovery, prototyping, development, deployment and ongoing technical project management. The team works with clients ranging from early-stage startups to listed enterprises, aiming to find the fundamental problem behind a brief early on rather than just building to a fixed specification.

Its technical stack spans React and React Native for front-end and mobile work, Node.js, .NET, Python and GraphQL on the back end, and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure using tools such as Docker and Kubernetes for deployment. That breadth lets Stackworx take a platform from early concept through to a production, continuously delivered system. Based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, Stackworx serves businesses needing custom software built by an experienced, end-to-end engineering team.

Steel and Pipes for Africa's Centurion branch, on Sarel Baard Crescent in Rooihuiskraal, is one of the steel, tubing and hardware merchant's branches, stocking steel goods, hardware, paint, roofing and fencing supplies for both DIY customers and contractors. The branch gives Centurion customers a local source for building materials that would otherwise mean a trip to a larger hardware chain or a specialist steel merchant.

Trading Monday to Friday and Saturday mornings, the branch suits contractors needing structural or fencing material as much as homeowners picking up paint or roofing supplies for a weekend project. As part of a wider steel, tube and hardware merchant network, the Rooihuiskraal branch has access to a broad product range while still serving customers from this one Centurion location.

Stonewolf Supply Co. is a firearms and tactical-gear distributor in Derdepoort, stocking rifles and handguns from brands such as Browning, Winchester and Daniel Defense, alongside tactical and sporting optics from names including Nightforce, Steiner and Burris. Its ammunition and reloading range covers factory rounds from Hornady, Fiocchi and Nosler as well as reloading equipment for shooters who load their own ammunition.

The distributor also carries air rifles, knives and tactical accessories from brands such as Gerber, Schrade and Puma, and promotes the brands it distributes through targeted marketing across print, digital and retail channels. Operating from an armoury facility in Derdepoort with direct forklift access for bulk handling, Stonewolf Supply Co. serves retailers and dealers across South Africa needing a single distributor for firearms, optics, ammunition and related tactical equipment.

Striptax is an accounting and tax compliance firm in Heritage Hill, Centurion, handling income tax returns, VAT and payroll tax services, and corporate tax planning for individuals and businesses. The firm also deals with tax dispute resolution, representing clients in disagreements with the South African Revenue Service rather than only handling routine filing.

Its services extend to foreign income and expatriate tax, a specialised area for South Africans working abroad or foreign nationals earning income locally, alongside company, VAT, provisional tax, income tax and PAYE registrations for businesses getting set up. Based in Heritage Hill Estate, Centurion, Striptax serves individuals and businesses across the Pretoria area who need both everyday tax compliance and more specialised support such as expatriate tax or dispute resolution handled by one firm.

Tar surfaces Pretoria, Asphalt Driveways & Brick paving Pretoria is a paving and surfacing contractor with over 20 years' experience, offering hot and cold mix asphalt, pothole patching, crack sealing, road milling and brick paving across Gauteng. The company also runs its own plant hire service, with excavators, rollers and other machinery available for short or long-term hire on top of its contracted paving work.

Its team combines civil and structural engineering know-how with hands-on paving experience, aiming to deliver durable, smooth surfaces for roads, driveways and parking lots rather than a quick cosmetic resurfacing. Open on weekdays and Saturday mornings, the company trades from Bourke Street in Sunnyside and serves residential, commercial and industrial clients across Gauteng needing anything from a single driveway to larger road and parking lot surfacing projects.

Tigercubs is a farming and agricultural-services company that has operated since 2012 across Limpopo, Gauteng, North West and Mpumalanga, supplying animal feeds, fertilisers, seeds, live animals and irrigation equipment to farmers and agricultural businesses. Livestock supplied includes pigs, poultry, sheep and cattle, giving the company a broader agricultural offering than a feed or seed supplier alone.

Alongside physical supplies, Tigercubs provides technical advisory and training on crop and animal production, mentoring clients through the practical side of farming rather than just selling inputs and walking away. Trading on weekdays from its Booysens base, the company serves farming communities across its four-province footprint, positioning itself as a supplier that also helps build farming skills and knowledge in the communities where it operates.

Timberware is a timber supplier in Koedoespoort Industrial serving DIY enthusiasts, builders and artisans with wood sheets, solid timber and PAR (planed-all-round) timber. The business is part of the Bron Joineries family, drawing on more than three decades of craftsmanship and reliability built up under that name before Timberware was launched as a dedicated public-facing timber supply arm.

Beyond selling raw material, the workshop offers precision planing, sanding and joining services, cutting and preparing timber from standard planks up to beams over three metres long so customers receive wood ready to use rather than needing to finish it themselves. Trading from Eland Street in Koedoespoort Industrial, Timberware serves builders and home renovators across Pretoria looking for quality timber and finishing work from a single, established supplier.

Tin Man Digital is a digital agency in Waterkloof Glen offering strategy, UX and UI design, and software and web development, including SaaS products and enterprise system integration. Rather than treating design and development as separate disciplines, the agency builds immersive apps and websites that connect data, processes and people within a single, coordinated project.

Its performance marketing team runs targeted, conversion-focused campaigns to support the platforms it builds, and its client list includes major automotive and financial brands, giving it experience working to the standards larger corporate clients expect. Based at Menlyn Maine in Waterkloof Glen, Tin Man Digital serves businesses that need both the technical delivery of a software or web platform and the marketing strategy to drive customers to it.

Tnsy Petroleum Consulting is a young, black-owned, female-led petroleum industry consultancy based in Louwlardia, Centurion, with more than 15 years of combined staff experience in the sector's economics and policy regulations. The consultancy helps clients secure wholesale and retail fuel licences from the Department of Mineral Resources and Energy, and prepares the business plans, feasibility studies and environmental impact assessments those applications require.

Its services extend to traffic counts, newspaper notices and workshops on the petroleum sector, plus support negotiating service station lease agreements and supply, transport, import and export agreements with oil companies and investors. Tnsy Petroleum also advises on basic fuel pricing. Open on weekdays, the consultancy serves clients across the upstream, midstream and downstream petroleum sectors who need to navigate South Africa's fuel licensing and regulatory requirements.

Tony's Seafood & Grill is a family-run restaurant in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, serving seafood and grilled meats with Portuguese and South African influences, including prawns, lamb chops, fillet steaks, T-bones, ribs, chicken kebabs and prego rolls. Platters are built to be shared, and the menu leans towards generous, hearty portions rather than a fine-dining presentation.

A curated wine list of South African favourites is matched with ice-cold beers, ciders and spirits, with each wine chosen for how it complements the food on offer. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating plus an air-conditioned smoking area, and offers takeaways for nearby residents who want the food without dining in. Open daily from mid-morning into the evening, Tony's Seafood & Grill serves families and groups across Lynnwood Ridge looking for a casual, generous seafood and grill menu.

Ubuntu Scrap Metals And Recycling is a scrap-metal buyer and recycler in Klerksoord, Akasia, purchasing copper, copper radiators, aluminium, aluminium cans, brass and stainless steel, as well as plastic, paper, cardboard and electronic waste. The business buys from homeowners, contractors, plumbers, electricians, manufacturers and demolition contractors, weighing material on digital scales and paying out immediately rather than asking sellers to wait for payment.

Collection is available directly from homes, building sites and businesses, saving customers the trip to a scrap yard themselves, and the company positions its pricing as fair and transparent against competitive, market-related rates. Based in Klerksoord, Akasia, Ubuntu Scrap Metals And Recycling serves both individuals clearing out scrap metal and tradespeople and businesses with a regular stream of recyclable material to dispose of responsibly.

Umjikelo Recruitment Services is an executive search and recruitment firm founded in 2009, offering head-hunting and senior and middle-management placements for clients across sectors including gaming, energy, media and ICT. Rather than filling only junior vacancies, the firm focuses on the harder-to-fill roles where client businesses need a more targeted search process.

Its services also include psychometric assessments to support hiring decisions, and enterprise-development beneficiary recruitment, placing candidates through transformation and development programmes that larger corporate clients run. Based at Lynnwood Bridge, Umjikelo Recruitment Services serves employers across several industries who need specialist recruitment support beyond a standard job-board listing, drawing on more than fifteen years in the executive search and placement field.

Unique Plus is a Rietondale-based creative design and media company offering graphic design work such as logos, branding, brochures and billboards, alongside 3D and 2D modelling and motion graphics for clients needing more than flat print design. The company also provides website design and search engine optimisation services, covering a client's online presence alongside its printed and physical branding.

On the media side, Unique Plus offers photography and videography for weddings and corporate events, giving it a client base that spans personal celebrations as well as business marketing work. Trading from Nuffield Street in Rietondale, Unique Plus serves clients across Pretoria who want design, web and media services handled by a single creative company rather than several separate specialists.

VennCap Business Solutions is a business consulting and funding platform based in Olympus, Pretoria, connecting entrepreneurs at different stages of the business lifecycle, from early-stage ventures through growth and established businesses to those preparing an exit, with investors able to fund them. The platform lets entrepreneurs create a business profile and apply for funding programmes suited to their particular stage.

On the investor side, VennCap runs an investor services portal for those looking to put capital into vetted businesses, acting as a matching point between entrepreneurs who need funding and investors looking for opportunities. Based in the Boardwalk Office Park in Olympus, VennCap Business Solutions serves South African entrepreneurs and investors who want a structured, stage-based approach to raising or deploying business capital rather than an informal introduction.

VerdanTech is a Die Wilgers-based digital marketing agency offering brand development, social media and paid advertising, website and e-commerce development, and lead generation for both B2B and B2C clients. Its graphic design and video production teams support campaigns with original content rather than relying solely on paid media placement.

The agency has also built tools around newer search behaviour, including a free scorecard that tells businesses how likely they are to be found and recommended by AI tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI, and offers AI-driven marketing automation and Generative Engine Optimisation as part of its service range. With a five-star rating across more than twenty Google reviews, VerdanTech works from The Willows Office Park in Die Wilgers, serving Pretoria businesses wanting both traditional digital marketing and newer AI-focused visibility tools.

VetsMart Lynnwood Bridge is a branch of the VetsMart national pet-retail chain, founded in 2004 by two veterinarians and built around the idea that pet nutrition is as much a part of pet wellness as veterinary care. The Lynnwood Bridge store stocks premium and super-premium pet food, toys, treats, grooming products, pharmacy items and accessories for dogs, cats and other household pets.

The branch has built up a strong local following, with over a thousand social media likes and dozens of customer reviews, and offers on-site parking for shoppers. Trading from Daventry Street in the Lynnwood Bridge Retail Centre, VetsMart Lynnwood Bridge serves pet owners across Lynnwood Manor looking for a specialist pet store with veterinary-informed product ranges rather than the limited pet aisle of a general supermarket.

Water Pump Group supplies and services borehole, booster, solar, centrifugal and slurry pumps, along with irrigation accessories, diesel engines, water storage tanks and electrical control panels. The company runs its own factory in Waltloo, Pretoria, giving it manufacturing capacity behind its pump range rather than only reselling imported equipment.

Alongside its Waltloo base, Water Pump Group operates branches across Gauteng and the Western Cape, putting pump sales and servicing within reach of customers in more than one region rather than requiring deliveries from a single national warehouse. The combination of pumps, storage tanks and control panels lets the company supply a complete water-pumping system rather than individual components, serving households, farms and businesses across Pretoria and beyond who need boreholes, irrigation or water storage set up or maintained.

We4Cused Trading and Projects, registered with the CIPC in 2015, began life focused on trucking and logistics before pivoting to general trading after struggling to secure funding for a transport-only business. In 2018 the company registered with IBM PartnerWorld to supply electronic, software and hardware equipment, and has since built up a broader supply offering covering office cleaning chemicals, stationery and electronics, alongside transport services across Gauteng.

More recently, the business has expanded into licensed petroleum products, supplying diesel at both 50ppm and 10ppm grades, along with oil and paraffin, delivering nationwide from its Karen Park base in Pretoria North. That shift from a single-focus logistics idea into a multi-product supply and fuel business reflects a company that has repeatedly adapted its offering to match what it could actually fund and deliver.

West Rand Box is a corrugated box manufacturer in Kirkney, Pretoria, with over 30 years' experience producing RSC boxes, die-cut boxes, telescoping boxes and custom corrugated packaging with flexographic printing. Its board range spans E-flute for lighter packaging and retail presentation, B-flute for general-purpose strength, C-flute for heavier products, and single and double wall boards for maximum protection.

That range lets the company supply packaging suited to the product being shipped rather than a single standard box for every job, serving agriculture, industrial, retail and transport customers with different protection needs. Based in Kirkney, Pretoria, West Rand Box works with businesses that need custom-sized or custom-printed corrugated packaging rather than generic stock boxes, backed by three decades of manufacturing experience in the corrugated packaging industry.

Weyer and Weyer Attorneys is a specialist conveyancing firm in Lyttelton, Centurion, that became a dedicated conveyance practice in 2006 and has since grown into one of the major conveyancing firms in the area. The firm handles property transfers, bond registrations and cancellations, sectional title extensions, and the administration of deceased estates, covering most of the legal work that follows a property changing hands.

Its conveyancing work is recognised by major South African banks, sitting on the bond registration panels of ABSA, Nedbank, FNB and Standard Bank, and the cancellation panels of ABSA and Standard Bank. That panel status means the firm regularly handles bond-related transfers on behalf of these banks' customers rather than only private conveyancing instructions. Based on Pretorius Avenue in Lyttelton, Weyer and Weyer Attorneys serves homeowners and banks across Centurion needing conveyancing and estate administration services.

WingFan Africa manufactures and supplies custom industrial axial fans, impellers and cooling equipment, covering applications from HVAC systems and cooling towers to livestock ventilation and heavy earth-moving and generator equipment. Its product range includes custom impellers, cased axial fans, air blast coolers and large-volume exhaust fans, alongside mancoolers for industrial sites needing personal cooling solutions.

A particular strength is rapid local manufacture of OEM replacement impellers, letting clients get a worn or damaged fan part replaced quickly rather than waiting on an imported original part and losing production time to downtime. Based at Route 21 Business Park in Irene, WingFan Africa serves industrial, agricultural and commercial customers across South Africa who need custom-engineered fans and cooling equipment rather than an off-the-shelf unit that doesn't quite fit their application.
